name: highlight-text
title: Highlight text
description: The headline reveal: each letter starts faint and red, fades up, then settles to ink, spreading from the centre or the start; trailing characters stay red.
use_for: The website hero and section titles; the console's greeting and search headline, once per session.
never: On a screen opened many times a day, every time
More than one on a screen
body: `as` picks the heading level, `text` the words and `accent` the trailing characters that stay red (the hero's full stop). Letters wait at 20% in red, fade up over 200ms, then settle to the heading's colour over 400ms; lines start 100ms apart and letters 40ms apart from the centre (from the start on left-aligned text). It plays once, when the heading comes on screen. The words are read once by screen readers. Without JavaScript and with reduced motion the text just shows. The two curves and the 400ms step are tokens of their own (`--ds-easing-reveal-fade`, `--ds-easing-reveal-ink`, `--ds-duration-reveal`).

examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import HighlightText from '@/components/visuals/HighlightText.vue'
// The reveal in the console, as Explorer's headline has it. Here it plays again every few seconds; in the product it
// plays once.
const round = ref(0)
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined
onMounted(() => { timer = setInterval(() => round.value++, 4000) })
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearInterval(timer))
</script>

<template>
  <HighlightText :key="round" as="h1" text="Explore your data" accent="." class="text-center type-heading-1 md:type-hero" />
</template>

<!-- The reveal in the console, as Explorer's headline has it. Here it plays again every few seconds (a new element in
     its place); in the product it plays once. -->
<conare-highlight-text id="explore" as="h1" text="Explore your data" accent="." class="text-center type-heading-1 md:type-hero"></conare-highlight-text>
<script type="module">
  let heading = document.getElementById('explore')
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    if (!heading.isConnected) return clearInterval(timer)
    const next = heading.cloneNode()
    heading.replaceWith(next)
    heading = next
  }, 4000)
</script>
